series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1VpOcpUx4CFeqhs9Yklgm3_ezzixvRQSM, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Seven passed on the first pass. Three were rerendered: IMG0271 had put the herdsman barefoot on volcanic scree against his locked boots and gaiters; IMG0279 repeated the Batch 027 shaved-side braid failure on two background figures and planted a wattle hurdle that read as a gallows; IMG0280 had dressed the elder in ermine-like fur and placed a snow-dusted alpine ridge with a rebuilt stone stair in a Valyrian frame. IMG0273 had a 12 px black letterbox strip and was reframed from 1376x756 to full-bleed 1376x768 before upload. Director's decision held throughout: the Amethyst Empress is never dramatised — no court, no crown, no writing; the myth exists only as weather and as one small amethyst trade bead in IMG0278. Continuity flags carried forward: uniform long loose or half-bound hair stated positively (not just banned), no shaved or undercut scalp, and no clothing darker than charcoal.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide dusk tableau — the clan around the fire, an old woman telling
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved rerender: eight clanfolk round the fire, the old woman mid-gesture. Every head is uniformly long, loose or half-bound silver-gold; the shaved-side braids are gone and no tall hurdle or scaffold stands in the background. Continuity flag: the man at the right wears a very dark charcoal tunic that reads near-navy at dusk — charcoal is within the locked palette but this shade must not deepen toward black in later frames.
